selectionReason: Nov 10 CPI upside surprise and Nov 10 TSMC October sales (+59.7% YoY) make HL001 (volatility vs thesis) and HL006 (growth vs valuation) relevant. Neither repeats Nov 10's HL005/HL023. Source: TSMC Nov 10 release; Reuters Nov 10 CPI report.

cards.title: The thesis must survive daily gyrations
cards.question: What changed: price or business assumptions?
cards.prompt: Use HL001 to distinguish Nov 10 CPI-driven repricing from changes in AI semiconductor demand. Check TSMC October sales and counterevidence; make a dated milestone list.

cards.title: A high P/E needs a growth explanation
cards.question: What growth is already priced in?
cards.prompt: Use HL006 to test how higher Treasury yields change the valuation of AI chip suppliers. Contrast revenue growth, earnings forecasts and multiples, with failure conditions.
